desc:
🎭 Steal a Glitch
One goal: Take their glitches before they take yours.

In Steal a Glitch, you’re not just collecting—you’re claiming what should be yours.
Build a team of powerful glitch characters, sneak into rival squads, and grab their strongest anomalies!

⚔️ Steal glitch characters from other players
💸 Earn coins and upgrade your power
🌀 Rebirth to unlock new zones and rare characters
🛡️ Defend your collection or risk losing it
🔥 PvP + Simulator + Tycoon = nonstop action

Do you have what it takes to steal them all?
